hero.filename: South Carolina National Guard sets up tents at Florence testing site (49898688241).jpg
hero.caption: U.S. Army National Guard Soldiers with the 174th Engineer Company, South Carolina National Guard, set up tents at a COVID-19 testing site, May 15, 2020 at Iola Jones Park in Florence, South Carolina, in support of the Medical University of South Carolina. The Soldiers constructed the tents to provide a covered area for the state's healthcare personnel to collect medical information from South Carolina citizens wanting to be tested. The South Carolina National Guard remains ready to support the counties, state and local agencies, and first responders with resources for as long as needed in support of COVID-19 response efforts in the state. (U.S. Army National Guard photo by Staff Sgt. Brad Mincey, South Carolina National Guard)

images.filename: Florence SC Amtrak Stations old ROWs.JPG
images.caption: Two former railroad sidings in the platform between the current and former former Florence Railroad Stations as seen from the entrance to the current station in Florence, South Carolina. The old station was originally a grand Atlantic Coast Line Railroad station, that became an Amtrak Station until 1996, when it moved into a smaller station next door. Now it's just another facility for the McLeod Regional Medical Center, although Amtrak still uses the old platforms. Note the skeletal steel canopy stretching from the station house to some other tracks in the right-of-way.

images.filename: Francis Marion University Center for Performing Arts.jpg
images.caption:
Resulting from a partnership between a range of public and private entities, the Performing Arts Center at Francis Marion University forms a new regional artistic hub, attracting audiences from the area and offering educational programs for students at the university.Hosting multiple academic, professional, local, and touring performing arts groups, the main 900-seat multi-purpose hall accommodates a range of performance genres. A patented moveable, one-piece orchestra shell transforms the auditorium from a music environment to a full stage house for theatrical presentations, ensuring optimal acoustics in either setting.

Located near the recently completed main library, little theater and future museum, the Center forms an anchor for a growing downtown Florence cultural district. Designed by Holzman Moss Bottino Architecture.

images.filename: GRIFFIN MOTOR COMPANY, FLORENCE COUNTY, SC.jpg
images.caption: BUILT IN 1950; THE BUILDING SERVED AS AN OLDSMOBILE DEALERSHIP AND SERVICE SHOP UNTIL 1962. GRIFFIN MOTOR COMPANY IS SIGNIFICANT FOR ITS ASSOCIATION WITH THE EVOLUTION OF CAR SALES AFTER WORLD WAR II AND FOR ITS ROLE IN THE EARLY HISTORY OF NASCAR AND THE DARLINGTON RACEWAY. images.filename: Florence (SC) Petro Stopping Center; Front Doors.jpg
images.caption: Main entrance to the Petro Stopping Center along Interstate 95 at Exit 169 (TV Road) near Florence, South Carolina. Petro and Petro Stopping Centers were acquired by Travel Centers of America on May 31, 2007, but TA still allowed that franchise to operate under it's own name. My previous attempt to capture other images of this franchise in October 2018 didn't go that well, so I was lucky enough to capture this and others. Taken from beneath the canopy for the BP gas pumps, while walking on foot.
